alerts.title: Viral load monitoring on DTG-based ART requires attention
alerts.message: Guideline excerpt (sahcs_adult_art_2024 p32) states that on two NRTIs plus DTG, viral load should be checked every 6 months, and may be reduced to 12-monthly only if VL is below 50 copies/mL for more than 1 year with reliable adherence. Patient has VL 30 copies/mL (2024-09-15) and 20 copies/mL (2025-09-15), both below 50, with good adherence reported. The most recent VL is 129 days old, so the 6-monthly check is approaching or due; no VL is recorded in the plan today. Creatinine 76 umol/L is recorded but no renal toxicity signal is present in the excerpts, and no drug toxicity is identified from the available data.

evidence.recommended_action: Confirm the next viral load is scheduled within 6-month interval per guideline; if VL remains below 50 copies/mL for over 1 year with reliable adherence, 12-monthly monitoring may be considered.
